summary: The purpose of this report is to advise that the City Manager will be submitting a supplementary report that provides a response to Council directive 2026.CC.38.1 to provide an update on the negotiations between the City and Province on executing a memorandum of understanding for uploading the Garinder Expressway and Don Valley Parkway.
decided: City Council on June 24 and 25, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the Interim Funding Approach and Framework and the Provincial Terms and Conditions for the Upload contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (June 22, 2026) from the City Manager and authorize the City Manager and their designates, and the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, to negotiate and execute a Transfer Payment Agreement with the Province to accept the provincial funding set out in the Interim Funding Approach and Framework, including any required amendments and extensions, on terms satisfactory to the City Manager, all in forms satisfactory to the City Solicitor 2. City Council approve in principle the terms of the Provincial Term Sheet contained in Confidential Attachment 2 to the supplementary report (June 22, 2026) from the City Manager and authorize the City Manager and their designates, and the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, to continue negotiations with the Ministry of Transportation on the implementation of the upload of the Expressways, and to report to Council to seek any authority as may be necessary to implement the Provincial Term Sheet. 3.
